venue.name: Mt. Prospect Public Library
venue.address: 10 S. Emerson St, Mount Prospect, IL 60056, USA

items.information: ## This competition takes place on a Monday. Please plan your attendance accordingly. Come to this competition to get all warmed up before [CubingUSA Nationals 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubingUSANationals2023) on Thursday! This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [WCA Competition Tutorial] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/tutorial.pdf). There is a one guest limit for this competition due to the size of the room. This also means that no outside spectators will be allowed. Join our [Facebook group](https://www.facebook.com/groups/2382471798653473/) to get notified when future competitions in the area get announced and to socialize with other speedcubers! This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association](https://www.midwestcubing.org/).

items.name: Warsaw Cube Masters 2023
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBdkJSIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--2ec91b0578bf841894ad746e0643e0b8635a99e3/logo_WCM.png) #### Warsaw Cube Masters powraca! Zapraszamy do Warszawy zarówno starych wyjadaczy jak i nowych zawodników aby razem spędzić czas w atmosferze kostkowego święta. Poprzednia edycja zaowocowała rekordem świata w wykonaniu Macieja Czapiewskiego, mamy więc nadzieję, że i tym razem nie zabraknie znakomitych wyników i rekordów. Liczymy, że uda się nam spędzić miło czas zacieśniając stare przyjaźnie i zawiązując nowe. Zachęcamy do przejrzenia wszystkich zakładek, znajdują się tam naprawdę przydatne informacje, a jeżeli nie wyczerpały one pytań, do kontaktu z nami za pomocą formularza dostępnego pod przyciskiem "Kontakt". --- #### Warsaw Cube Masters returns! We invite both old timers and new competitors to Warsaw to spend time in atmosphere of cubing festivity. Previous edition resulted in spectacular world record by Maciej Czapiewski so we hope that this time there will be a lot of great results and records as well. We also hope to nurture old cubing friendships and create some new while spending good time at the competition. Please visit all tabs, you will be able to find there very useful informations, and if they will not answer all of your questions don't hesitate to contact us via form available under "Contact" button.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb3BnIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--ed08f4d13f7870a50d29aacfd41dd6a155c5ad2f/unnamed%20(1).png) ![](https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1019092248614424637/1182038138156232814/WCA_Newcomer_Month_LOGO_A1_12.png?ex=65833dcd&is=6570c8cd&hm=8601e1d3b9f4839c2e67ef9936687a271a917d082791b5a0fbd068754df11b32&) This competition is participating in the official WCA Newcomer Month 2024. The registration process will reserve 25% of spots for new competitors. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID with 2024. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2023 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete. Registrations will be accepted based on the following: 25% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors. Initially, 75% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are available for returning competitors on a first come, first serve basis. If greater than 25% of new competitors register before 75% of spots are filled by returning competitors, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors. If the spots reserved for new competitors are not filled by new competitors before registration closes two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors.

items.information: [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcGd3IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--413963af1d32608ec1038d304a181c8adedb8510/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png)](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) ## Please Be Quiet This isn't your typical speed solving competition as ***blindfolded events*** are the only events. Blindfolded events require a significant amount of learning, practice and concentration. All attendees, including competitors and guests, are asked to please remain quiet at this competition to allow competitors to concentrate. If you are looking to compete in the traditional 3x3x3 Cube event or other timed events, please look for [another competition in Canada](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada). ## FMC Canada 2025 We will take a break in the middle of the day to hold [FMC Canada 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMCCanada2025) at the same venue. You may compete in both competitions, but **you must register for each competition separately**. ## Note for New Competitors Although first-timers are welcome to compete if they know how to solve puzzles blindfolded (please note Regulation [2k6](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2k6)), this might not be the best experience for new competitors. Please consider registering for [another competition](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada) if this one isn't for you. You can also follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. ## Registration Reminders You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details. ## Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

items.information: ## Waterloo Favourites 2023 Series This competition is in a series with [Waterloo Favourites B 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WaterlooFavouritesB2023). You will only be able to compete in *one* of these two competitions. Attempting to register for both competitions will result in only one of your registrations being accepted. ## Registration Reminders Since this is a "favourites" competition, **you may choose at most four (4) events**. You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations and registrations with more than four (4) events will not be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details. Once your registration has been accepted, you will no longer be able to change your events by yourself. If you would like to change them, send the organization team an email and we will change your events for you as long as you inform us before February 4, 2023 at 7:00 PM EST. ## Mailing List We are aware of the extremely high demand for competitions in Ontario. We are working hard to meet and keep up with the demand and are regularly planning and announcing more and larger competitions. Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](http://speedcubingcanada.org) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. items.information: ## 포항에서 열리는 첫 WCA 대회! WCA 공인 대회에 처음 참가 하신다면, 참가 신청 전에 [첫 참가자 안내](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WeLaughPohanghang2025#63182-for-new-competitors) 탭과 [자주 묻는 질문](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WeLaughPohanghang2025#63181-frequently-asked-questions) 탭을 확인하십시오. 모든 참가자는 [WCA 규정](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/)을 숙지하여야 합니다. WCA 규정 [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/#1e2)와 [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/#1f2)에 따라, 모든 참가자는 운영진의 요청이 있을 시 스태프 업무를 수행해야 합니다. 원할한 기록 측정을 위하여 [대회 참가 안내 영상](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QfPqba-eKrc)을 시청하여 주십시오. 원할한 스태프 업무 수행을 위하여 [스태프 규정 영상](https://youtu.be/3saR3HMi4JM?si=QdOG0tvo_5CvoDCz)을 시청하여 주십시오. ___ ## First WCA competition in Pohang City! If this is your first official WCA competition, please read the [For New Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WeLaughPohanghang2025#63182-for-new-competitors) tab and the [Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WeLaughPohanghang2025#63181-frequently-asked-questions) tab before registering. All competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Due to WCA Regulations [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2) and [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2), all competitors are required to fulfill staff duties at the organizers' request. Please watch [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QfPqba-eKrc) to get familiar with WCA official competitions. Please watch [this video](https://youtu.be/3saR3HMi4JM?si=QdOG0tvo_5CvoDCz) to get familiar with staff duties.

venue.address: Ευελπίδων 2 και Μαυρομματαίων Πεδίον του Άρεως, Αθηνα, 10434

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTUwOTk2LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--0957dc19d529cfafc15d8fd76a27f79343c71e35/df2ac7a9-5a2b-4eb6-8e8a-7cd201d87a3e.jpg) **Προσοχή:** Ο διαγωνισμός αυτός είναι το Α μέρος σειράς δύο διαγωνισμών. Μπορείτε να συμμετάσχετε **μόνο σε έναν από τους δύο**. Ο 3x3 είναι και στους δύο διαγωνισμούς οπότε διαλέξτε με προσοχή ποια μέρα ή πoιο από τα 2x2, One Handed 3x3, Pyarminx ή 4x4, 5x5, skewb επιθυμείτε. Ο πρώτος διαγωνισμός για το 2026! Ελάτε να περάσουμε όμορφα σε ένα απίθανο cozy μέρος το ολοκαίνουριο Panellinios Club House. Σας περιμένουμε στο **We Love Cubing Athens A 2026.** Αγωνίσματα Α' διαγωνισμού: * 3x3 * 2x2 * One Handed 3x3 * Pyraminx Παρακαλoύμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στο σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στην WCA **KAI** να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής με χρήση της τραπεζικής σας κάρτας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. [Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg) [Πώς να είσαι κριτής σε διαγωνισμό κύβων του Ρούμπικ.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=x5KaXXoh7XI) **Note:** This competition is part A of a series of two competitions. You can participate in **only one of the two**. 3x3 is in both contests so choose carefully which day or which of 2x2, One Handed 3x3, Pyraminx or 4x4, 5x5, Skewb you prefer. The first competition of 2026! Come join us for a great time in an amazing cozy venue, the brand-new Panellinios Club House. We’re waiting for you at **We Love Cubing Athens A 2026.** Competition Α events: * 3x3 * 2x2 * One Handed 3x3 * Pyraminx Please read the following tab very carefully to find all the necessary information. Note: For a registration to be considered valid, the competitor should both register though the WCA site **AND** pay the registration fee as described in the nexts tabs. Please read the following tabs in detail to find all the necessary information.

items.information: **[FR]** **Suite aux annonces par le gouvernement du Québec sur le [Passeport vaccinal](https://www.quebec.ca/sante/problemes-de-sante/a-z/coronavirus-2019/deroulement-vaccination-contre-la-covid-19/passeport-de-vaccination-covid-19/lieux-et-activites-exigeant-passeport-vaccinal-covid-19), tous les compétiteurs et leurs accompagnateurs devront présenter leur passeport vaccinal et une pièce d'identité avec photo à l'entrée du site de compétition. L'accès à la compétition sera refusé à tous ceux qui ne peuvent présenter un passeport valide. Un questionnaire d'accueil devra également être rempli au préalable, voir l'[onglet Preuve de vaccination](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WelcomeBackLevis2021#16710-preuve-de-vaccination-vaccination-proof) pour plus de détails. Dans l'éventualité où les directives gouvernementales changent, les compétiteurs seront avisés par courriel.** Également, il est à noter que **les citoyens étrangers qui désirent voyager au Canada doivent être admissibles au statut de [voyageurs entièrement vaccinés](https://voyage.gc.ca/voyage-covid/voyage-restrictions/voyageurs-vaccines-covid-entrent-canada) et suivre les instructions détaillées sur le site du gouvernement canadien.** Veuillez lire **tous les onglets** sur cette page web. C'est très important. En raison de la COVID-19, **il y aura des nouveautés même pour les compétiteurs chevronnés**. Portez une attention particulière à l'[onglet Santé & Sécurité](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WelcomeBackLevis2021#16705-sante-securite-health-safety) ainsi qu'à notre [Plan d'atténuation des risques]https://docs.google.com/document/d/121IA2o1dPWAdlqZNCO0KyVLceeFsbFENTiVlMPThAkU/edit?usp=sharing) conforme aux directives de la WCA. Note : **1 accompagnateur maximum par compétiteur**. Si vous n'êtes pas un compétiteur ou accompagnateur, nous vous demandons de ne pas venir. Note : Dans la cas où la situation en lien avec la pandémie COVID-19 devient drastiquement pire et que les directives changent, il se peut que la WCA cancelle la compétition. Les mises à jour importantes seront affichées sur ce site et envoyées directement par courriel aux compétiteurs. **[EN]** **As per the Quebec government's recently announced [Proof of Vaccination Requirement](https://www.quebec.ca/en/health/health-issues/a-z/2019-coronavirus/progress-of-the-covid-19-vaccination/covid-19-vaccination-passport/places-and-activities-requiring-covid-19-vaccination-passport), all competitors and their (single) guest must present a valid proof of vaccination and a valid piece of ID with photo in order to enter the venue. Also, a welcome questionnaire will have to be filled, see the [Vaccination proof tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WelcomeBackLevis2021#16710-preuve-de-vaccination-vaccination-proof) for more details. We will send registered competitors further details in an email if the government updates its regulations.** Moreover, note that **individuals arriving from outside of Canada need to qualify as [fully vaccinated travellers](https://travel.gc.ca/travel-covid/travel-restrictions/covid-vaccinated-travellers-entering-canada) and follow the Canadian government policies detailed on the website.** Please **review ALL of the tabs listed on this website**. This is a priority. **Even if you are a seasoned competitor, COVID-19 has created some new conditions** and there are things to be particularly attentive to. Take clear note especially of the [Health and Safety Tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WelcomeBackLevis2021#16705-sante-securite-health-safety) and our full WCA-compliant [Risk Mitigation Plan](https://docs.google.com/document/d/121IA2o1dPWAdlqZNCO0KyVLceeFsbFENTiVlMPThAkU/edit?usp=sharing). Note: **Only one (1) spectator per competitor** can attend. **If you're not a competitor or the single guest of a competitor, then we ask you NOT to come.** Note: **In the unlikely event that the COVID-19 situation concerningly worsens**, the WCA may step in and cancel the competition. Significant updates such as these will be posted here on the website and emailed to registered competitors.

items.information: Wellington Mind Games 2020 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. It is focused on some of the more mentally demanding events, that are given less of a focus in normal competitions - blindfolded and fewest moves solving, specifically. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience or skill. There will also be event-based time limits in place, to ensure we stay on schedule, especially given the time taken by fewest moves solving. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations. **The main event of this competition is Fewest Moves**

items.information: **Deutsch** **Berlin ist Mega!** Wir laden euch herzlich ein zur Westend Mega NxNxN Competition in Berlin, im schönen Bezirk Charlottenburg, Ortsteil Westend. Euch erwartet eine schöne Venue direkt an der Stadtautobahn mitten in Berlin, tolle Disziplinen und vor allem großzügige Cutoffs, ein motiviertes Orga-Team und vieles mehr. **Bitte lies dir alle Tabs sorgfältig durch, damit du mit dem Zeitplan und allen Modalitäten vertraut bist.** **English** **Berlin is Mega!** We warmly invite you to the Westend Mega NxNxN Competition in Berlin, in the beautiful Westend part of the district Charlottenburg. We, the organizing team, look forward to seeing you there. You can expect a beautiful venue right next to the city highway in the heart of Berlin, great disciplines, and, above all, generous cutoffs, a motivated organizing team, and much more. **Please read all tabs carefully so you are familiar with the schedule and all modalities.**

items.information: ##### *English version is below* #### **Deutsch:** Wir freuen uns sehr euch "Wiener Frühling 2023" als ein offizielles WCA Turnier ankündigen zu können. Die Speedcubing Competition wird organisiert von Pranjal Khan, Florian Truckenthanner, David Dinh, Dániel Varga und Felix Strasser und wird delegiert von Bence Barát, Emma Beranová und Viktor Kalmar. Erneut findet das Turnier im großen Saal der Akkonplatz Pfarre statt. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt. Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. Es sind alle Herzlich willkommen! Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich! ----- #### **English:** We are happy to announce "Wiener Frühling 2023" as an official WCA Competition. The speedcubing competition is organised by Pranjal Khan, Florian Truckenthanner, David Dinh, Dániel Varga, Felix Strasser and is delegated by Bence Barát, Emma Beranová and Viktor Kalmar. The results of the competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations.

items.name: Wiler Würfelfäst für Afänger 2024
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBc0phIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--757a22c30b75dcff95194ffd68cb7c180c714d6e/WCA%20Newcomer%20Month%20LOGO_A1.jpg) deutsch Die "Wiler Würfelfäst für Afänger 2024" **im Rahmen des offiziellen WCA Newcomer Month** richtet sich insbesondere an neue und unerfahrene Cuber. Sie ist ausserdem Partner-Competition vom "10 Johr Wiler Würfelfäst 2024". Bitte beachte, dass du nur an einem der beiden Wettbewerbe teilnehmen kannst. Wenn du dich für beide Wettbewerbe anmeldest, so zählt nur die erste Anmeldung und wir werden die zweite (spätere) Anmeldung unverzüglich löschen. Bei der Anmeldung werden 50% der Plätze für neue Teilnehmende reserviert. Als neue Teilnehmende gelten Teilnehmer:innen ohne WCA-ID oder mit einer WCA-ID aus dem Jahr 2024. Wiederkehrende Teilnehmende haben eine WCA-ID, die aus dem Jahr 2023 oder früher stammt. Alle Teilnehmenden müssen weiterhin alle Registrierungsanforderungen erfüllen, damit ihre Registrierung als vollständig gilt. Weitere Informationen zur Annahme der Anmeldungen findet ihr im Tab "Newcomer Month". engl. This edition "Wiler Würfelfäst für Afänger 2024" is participating **in the official WCA Newcomer Month** and is especially directed towards new and inexperienced competitors. It is also a partner competition of the "10 Johr Wiler Würfelfäst 2024". Please note that you can only compete in one of the two competitions. If you register for both competitions, only the first registration will be valid and we will immediately delete the second (later) registration. The registration process will reserve 50% of spots for new competitors. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID with 2024. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2023 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete. Further information on the acceptance of registrations can be found in the tab "Newcomer Month".

Mai 2026 in Wuppertal Cronenberg einzuladen! Euch erwartet ein spannendes Wochenende voller Würfelspaß, Bestzeiten und einer großartigen Community. Ob Newcomer oder erfahrener Cuber – alle sind herzlich willkommen! Meldet euch an und seid dabei – wir freuen uns auf euch. **English** Dear speedcubers and cube fans, We’re super excited to invite you to the Wuppertal Cube Weekend on May 16–17, 2026 in Wuppertal Cronenberg! Expect an exciting weekend full of cube fun, personal bests, and an amazing community. Whether you’re a newcomer or an experienced cuber – everyone is welcome! Sign up and join us – we’re looking forward to seeing you!

items.name: Wuppertaler Würfel Wochenende 2 2026
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTc0MTMyLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--9a458e6deff7a3097077605b82ba6ed6cb6f8495/60d4732d-5344-4eab-a473-19f2d1891969.png) **German** Liebe Cuberinnen und Cuber, wir freuen uns, euch zum 2. Wuppertaler Würfel-Wochenende 2026 am 24. und 25. Oktober 2026 einzuladen. Nach zwei erfolgreichen Ausgaben im Herbst 2025 und Frühjahr 2026 heißen wir euch erneut in Wuppertal zu einem offiziellen WCA-Wettbewerbswochenende willkommen. Teilnehmende aller Erfahrungsstufen sind herzlich eingeladen – ganz gleich, ob es eure erste Competition ist oder ihr bereits an vielen Wettbewerben teilgenommen habt. Wir freuen uns auf ein Wochenende mit offiziellen Solves, neuen persönlichen Bestzeiten und dem Austausch mit der Community. Bitte lest vor der Anmeldung alle Informationen auf der Wettbewerbsseite sorgfältig durch. Wir hoffen, euch in Wuppertal zu sehen! **English** Dear cubers, We are excited to invite you to the 2nd Wuppertal Cubing Weekend 2026 on October 24–25, 2026. Following two successful editions in autumn 2025 and spring 2026, we are once again delighted to welcome you to Wuppertal for an official WCA competition weekend. Participants of all experience levels are warmly invited to join—whether this is your very first competition or you have already attended many events. We look forward to a weekend of official solves, new personal bests, and connecting with the cubing community. Please make sure to read all information on the competition page carefully before registering. We hope to see you in Wuppertal!

items.name: Wuppertaler Würfel Wochenende 2025
items.information: **German** Liebe Speedcuber, liebe Würfelfans, wir freuen uns riesig, euch zum 1. Wuppertaler Würfel Wochenende am 11. und 12. Oktober 2025 einzuladen! Zum ersten Mal wird in Wuppertal ein offizielles Speedcubing-Event stattfinden – und ihr könnt dabei sein! Euch erwartet ein spannendes Wochenende voller Drehspaß, Bestzeiten und einer großartigen Community. Egal, ob Newcomer oder erfahrener Cuber – jeder ist herzlich willkommen! Meldet euch an, seid dabei – wir freuen uns auf euch! **English** Dear speedcubers, dear cube fans, We are delighted to invite you to the 1st Wuppertal Cube Weekend on 11 and 12 October 2025! For the first time, an official speedcubing event will take place in Wuppertal - and you can be part of it! You can expect an exciting weekend full of fun, personal records and a great community. Whether you're a newcomer or an experienced cuber - everyone is welcome! Sign up, be there - we look forward to seeing you!

The IMAC auditorium is ready to welcome all of you on their beautiful instalations so you can enjoy the most this two day competition. This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).

items.information: - This competition is participating in the official WCA Newcomer Month 2025. The registration process will reserve N% of spots for new competitors. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID with 2025. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2024 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete. - Registrations will be accepted based on the following: - 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors. - Initially, 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are available for returning competitors on a first come, first serve basis. - If greater than 50% of new competitors register before 50% of spots are filled by returning competitors, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors. - If the spots reserved for new competitors are not filled by new competitors before registration closes two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors. - Please check the competition website for more information.

items.information: 8/21に行われるYoga Summer A 2022 (**本大会 / 以下、A大会**) と8/28に行われる[Yoga Summer B 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/YogaSummerB2022) (以下、B大会) は 、WCA シリーズ大会です。 ### シリーズ大会では、そのうち１つだけに参加できます。 複数に申込んだ場合は、申込完了日時が最も早いものだけを受理し、その他は無効となります。 なお、A大会とB大会は開催種目が異なります。ご留意ください。 **A大会: 3x3x3 キューブ (2ラウンド) / ピラミンクス / 3x3x3 目隠し / 4x4x4 目隠し / 5x5x5 目隠し** B大会: 3x3x3 キューブ (3ラウンド) / 2x2x2 キューブ / 4x4x4 キューブ / メガミンクス 新型コロナウイルス感染症 (COVID-19) 対策のため、本大会では会場への入場者数を制限しています。 飛び込みでの競技参加や見学はできません。 会場の広さの都合上、本大会の**見学申請は、競技参加者１名につき同伴者１名**に制限しています。 競技参加者１名につき２名以上の同伴や、その他**一般からの見学申請は受け付けておりません。** また、見学希望者多数の場合は未成年の同伴者など配慮を必要とする方を優先する場合があります。 Yoga Summer A 2022 (**This competition, A**) and [Yoga Summer B 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/YogaSummerB2022) (B) are WCA Series Competitions. ### You can register either of these series competitions. If you register for multiple competitions, the earliest one will only be received, and the others will be rejected. Please make sure that the events for A and B are different. **A: 3x3x3 Cube (2 round) / Pyraminx / 3x3x3 blindfolded / 4x4x4 blindfolded / 5x5x5 blindfolded** B: 3x3x3 Cube (3 round) / 2x2x2 Cube / 4x4x4 Cube / Megaminx The number of persons in the venue is controlled as a COVID-19 countermeasure. **Spectators are only permitted as companions of competitors.** Being mindful of space, we require that **each competitor bring at most 1 guest.** If the number of requests would become too many, a certain prioritization might be applied. (Ex. Guardians for minors)

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MzcxMTgsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--65176dceb5a653113b9a7ce41294d2d1043cdf37/yollotl.png) **ESPAÑOL** El amor por los cubos va más allá de solo resolver un rompecabezas; es una pasión que desafía la mente, agudiza la concentración y une a personas con el mismo entusiasmo. En la competencia Yollotl Tlaxcala 2024, te invitamos a ser parte de esta experiencia única, donde no solo pondrás a prueba tu habilidad y velocidad, sino que también compartirás momentos inolvidables con una comunidad vibrante de cuberos. Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia oficial de la Asociación Mundial de Cubos. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) antes de la competencia. **English** The love for cubes goes beyond just solving a puzzle; it's a passion that challenges the mind, sharpens focus, and brings together people who share the same enthusiasm. At the Yollotl Tlaxcala 2024 competition, we invite you to be part of this unique experience, where you'll not only test your skill and speed but also share unforgettable moments with a vibrant community of cubers. This competition is recognized as an official competition of the World Cube Association. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) prior to competition.

items.information: # **ATENÇÃO: esta competição só terá modalidades com os olhos vendados** * Os pagamentos devem ser feitos com antecedência para confirmar o registro na competição * O acesso ao local será permitido mediante comprovação de esquema vacinal completo, ou, uma dose de vacina e teste negativo para Covid-19 do tipo PCR, realizado até 48 horas antes do ingresso no local, ou do tipo antígeno, realizado até 24 horas antes do ingresso no estabelecimento (para o competidor e o acompanhante). Para as crianças menores de 12 anos, será solicitado o teste negativo de Covid-19 do tipo PCR, realizado até 48 horas antes do ingresso no estabelecimento, ou do tipo antígeno, realizado até 24 horas antes do acesso ao local. * Levar sua própria caneta e produtos de higiene pessoal: álcool gel, lenços e etc. ***A inscrição só será efetivada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento. Assim, as inscrições estarão limitadas aos 20 primeiros pagantes.*** -------------------- # **ATTENTION: this competition will hold only blindfolded events** * Payments must be made in advance to confirm registration * Access to the venue will be allowed upon proof of the complete vaccination schedule, or a dose of vaccine and negative test for Covid-19 of the PCR type, took up to 48 hours before entering the venue, or of the antigen type, took up to 24 hours before entry into the establishment (for both competitor and companion). For children under 12 years of age, a negative Covid-19 PCR test will be required, took within 48 hours before entering the establishment, or an antigen test took within 24 hours before entering the venue. * Bring your own pen and personal hygiene products: alcohol gel, handkerchiefs and etc. ***Registration will only be confirmed at the WCA website after payment confirmation. Thus, registrations will be limited to the first 20 payers.***

items.information: ## Português **Note que este campeonato possui APENAS modalidades vendadas.** * O pagamento da inscrição deve ser feito antecipadamente, todas as instruções se encontram na aba de *inscrever-se* do campeonato. * A inscrição **NÃO** será aceita até que o pagamento e o comprovante sejam enviados. Sem isso sua inscrição não será aprovada e você não poderá competir. ***A inscrição só será efetivada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento. Assim, as inscrições estarão limitadas aos 16 primeiros pagantes. Caso o número de inscritos exceda este limite, será usada uma lista de espera de acordo com a ordem do pagamento.*** -------------------- ## English **Please note that this competition ONLY has blindfolded events** * The payment of the registration fee must be made in advance. All the relevant instructions can be found under the *register* tab. * The registration **WILL NOT** be accepted until the payment is done and the receipt is sent. Otherwise, your registration will not be accepted and you will not be allowed to competed at the day of the competition. ***Registration will only be confirmed at the WCA website after payment confirmation. Thus, registrations will be limited to the first 16 payers. If the number of registrations exceeds this limit, a waiting list will be put in place ordered by de date of payment.***

items.name: Zvornik Open 2023
items.information: This is the 10th WCA competition in Bosnia and Herzegovina. The competition is open to all persons from all countries. **Note**: there is a maximum limit of ten competitors in the 3x3x3 multiblind event, on a first-come, first-served basis. If you register for multiblind after the ten slots have been filled you will be placed on a waiting list in case anybody deletes their registration later. There will be certificates and medals for all competitors in top 3 of an event. ================ Ovo je 10. WCA takmičenje u Bosni i Hercegovini. Takmičenje je otvoreno za sve osobe iz svih zemalja. **Napomena**: može biti maksimalno deset takmičara u 3x3x3 multiblind disciplini, po principu „prvi dođe, prvi uslužen“. Ako se registruje za multiblind nakon što je deset mjesta popunjeno, bit ćete stavljeni na listu čekanja, i vraćeni sa iste u slučaju da neko kasnije izbriše svoju registraciju. Za sve takmičare u prva 3 mjesta biće dodeljeni sertifikati i medalje.
